shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n' && node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\""
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "react-datepicker monthsShown renderCustomHeader changeMonth selected month panel index" --json --top-k 5'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"setPreSelection\" src/index.tsx src/calendar.tsx | head -50; sed -n '240,300p' src/index.tsx; sed -n '1045,1105p' src/calendar.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '895,940p' src/index.tsx; rg -n \"onMonthChange\" src/test/datepicker_test.test.tsx src/test/calendar_test.test.tsx | head -40; rg -n \"monthDate\" src/test/datepicker_test.test.tsx | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'node_modules/.bin/jest src/test/datepicker_test.test.tsx --runInBand -t "should reset monthSelectedIn when changing month from a custom header"'
/bin/bash -lc 'node_modules/.bin/prettier --check src/index.tsx src/test/datepicker_test.test.tsx && git diff --check && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/react-datepicker-month-navigation-anchor.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Reset multi-month display anchors during calendar navigation

When a multi-month date picker tracks the panel used for the last day selection, month navigation must clear that selection anchor before rendering the new range. Otherwise a custom header jump can keep placing the navigated month at the previously selected panel index. Keep the reset in the date-picker navigation boundary while still forwarding the public month-change callback.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/index.tsx | sed -n '938,960p;1476,1495p'; nl -ba src/test/datepicker_test.test.tsx | sed -n '2838,2895p'; git diff --stat"
